items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: they honored Bill Cobs, but Joe was in the audience.

ctx.x: Yeah. I guess he had a big party at Liberace’s estate.

Yeah. “From the home of Liberace,” oh, that would be like Joe. I saw him at the White House, they did a thing at Christmas in Washington, D.C, no, no it was a thing at the Kennedy Center where they honored Bill Cobs, but Joe was in the audience.
By the way, have you ever read his biography?
